title: Great little laptop
body:
I've not bought a computer since 2010 so I was very interested to see how things had moved on since then. 
This laptop is small and light but still pleasantly large enough. It was easy to set up by following the onscreen instructions. It loads really quickly too! You can set up log in via password or face recognition. The screen is bright and colourful. The keyboard keys are large but securely imbedded. Microsoft Office software is included but it is basic. There is also co pilot ai which helps with searches, constructing emails and other documents. It came fully charged and I've only had to charge it once so far which was quite quick, 20-85% in 30 minutes.
I have found it very different from previous Windows operating systems. Rather than programs there are apps which have taken some getting use to. More like a crossover of mobile devices and traditional computers. 
I did struggle to set up my gmail/outlook (more tricky) email accounts but managed to find a way around it so I can access them both. 
My one disappointment was that there was only one USB A port. Luckily, I already had a USB A hub I could use. 
Overall, I've been really impressed so far. Still lots more to explore on it when I get the time.
product_name: HP OmniBook 5 14" 2K Laptop, Snapdragon X, 16GB RAM, 512GB SSD
